description: This file contains test code for the mod_ssi module in a C-based web server. It includes functions to reset request state, write test files, and read from file descriptors to test server-side includes (SSI) features such as variable echo, execution commands, and file inclusion. The main function initializes necessary data structures, calls test routines, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: void test_mod_ssi_reset(request_st * const r,handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Resets the request and handler context data structures to initial states.

methods.name: void test_mod_ssi_write_testfile(int fd,const char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a file descriptor with the specified buffer content.

methods.name: void test_mod_ssi_read_fd(request_st * const r,handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Performs a series of tests reading SSI directives from a file descriptor, asserting expected behavior.

methods.name: void test_mod_ssi(void)
methods.description: Main test function that initializes the environment, runs SSI tests, and cleans up.

ctags.name: test_mod_ssi_reset
ctags.pattern: /^static void test_mod_ssi_reset (request_st * const r, handler_ctx * const hctx)$/

ctags.name: test_mod_ssi_write_testfile
ctags.pattern: /^static void test_mod_ssi_write_testfile (int fd, const char *buf, size_t len)$/
